rules.text: At least 40% of the assessment (by unit weighting) must be taken in the series in which the final grade is requested.
Each unit may be re-sat once before cash-in; the better result counts unless the unit is needed for the 40% terminal rule, in which case the more recent mark counts.
Students should ideally have covered all of GCSE Mathematics at Higher Tier, including the content of units M4 and M8, before Further Mathematics.
